tools.name: bulk_delete_submissions

tools.name: get_workspace

tools.name: delete_workspace

tools.name: redeem_voucher

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_public_form_html, list_form_webhooks, list_templates · Private data: set_auth_token, get_auth_status, register, login, login_with_google, accept_invite, generate_workspace_api_token, list_form_exports, download_export · Public sink: login, update_form, list_form_webhooks, add_form_webhook, delete_form_webhook, submit_form, submit_demo, resend_submission_email, invite_workspace_member, list_templates, generate_ai_content · Destructive: delete_form, delete_form_webhook, delete_submission, delete_all_form_submissions, bulk_delete_submissions, delete_workspace, generate_workspace_api_token, remove_workspace_member, delete_template_admin, delete_user_admin, bulk_delete_users_admin.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_public_form_html, list_form_webhooks, list_templates · Private data: set_auth_token, get_auth_status, register, login, login_with_google, accept_invite, generate_workspace_api_token, list_form_exports, download_export · Public sink: login, update_form, list_form_webhooks, add_form_webhook, delete_form_webhook, submit_form, submit_demo, resend_submission_email, invite_workspace_member, list_templates, generate_ai_content · Destructive: delete_form, delete_form_webhook, delete_submission, delete_all_form_submissions, bulk_delete_submissions, delete_workspace, generate_workspace_api_token, remove_workspace_member, delete_template_admin, delete_user_admin, bulk_delete_users_admin

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
